scope: Controls-first cold-host comparison of joint ACFT Q8/notebook-style dynamic-context and stock Whisper base Q5/full-context configurations; not the publisher product-context recipe.

method.arm_order: Alternating AB/BA by case; no retries.

short_quiet_french_control.source: Synthetic single-word negative answer at digital gain 0.1.

acft.output_category: Nonempty unrelated English-like word without the expected negation.

short_quiet_french_control.interpretation: The expected negative meaning was not preserved in the textual output. This was not silence or an equivalent negative answer in another language. It does not establish an affirmative-polarity inversion.
short_quiet_french_control.timestamp_note: Candidate segment began at zero and extended beyond the source duration. Existing emitted-text rules retained its text, so filtering did not cause the missing marker.

rejection_scope: This exact joint configuration failed the predefined marker gate on one short digitally attenuated synthetic French control. The remaining screen was stopped; there is no seven-language quality verdict or promotion.

provenance.independent_audit: PASS: model/source/library bindings, input identities, all six raw/log/receipt chains and raw/emitted scoring independently checked.

limitations: No ordinary DEV speech pair ran; zero normal totals in the private result mean no data, not zero errors.
Reduced noise insertions are not silence safety: the candidate still emitted text on both noise controls.
Model weights, quantization and encoder context changed together; this does not isolate their causal effects.
This run used round(frames / 320) + 8 without a context floor. Its rejection does not evaluate the publisher product-context recipe with a minimum context and larger margin.
Synthetic audio intelligibility was not independently adjudicated by listening.
All time measurements are cold host-process observations, not Android or physical-phone performance.
No held-out, continuous multiwindow, microphone, battery, thermal or background-reliability result.
